section: Closing strips and fillers for Maxima and Intarsio
source_pages: printed p.434 / PDF 436 (subset extracted: the H.60 row of the FIRST position)
family_note: No family-level keys - tall_top_h60.json owns them. See fillers_h78.json.
why_now_note: BE0151 WAS READ AND NOT HELD UNTIL TODAY, and the reason it was blocked has gone. _manifest recorded it as 'a filler naming a family the map does not contain' - the catalog's BASE chapter has no H.60 section. It does not; the TOP-ELEMENT chapter does, printed p.172, and that family is now held. A filler may not be held before its family; this one now has one. AND IT MATTERS: printed p.434's first position prints 60 and does NOT print 72, so choosing an H.60 top row gives the run a front-only closing strip that an H.72 row would not have had.

filler_front.description: Filler in door finishes from 2,3 to 15 cm - front in door finishes

front_layout.note: One finished front covering the whole face. NO hinge_axis and no mechanism - A FILLER DOES NOT OPEN. The kind is STATED rather than left absent because Panel.effective_slabs defaults a missing layout to single, and a default is not a source.

filler_front.notes: Depth 22, the figure decided 2026-08-24 from the page's own art for every code in this position. THE WIDTH IS ORDERED, NOT CODED: one article covers 23 to 150, and Registry.with_ordered_width turns the range into a number before anything is drawn.
